verdict: Colgate-Palmolive grew sales 4.6% to $5.4B with growth in every product category, and a richer mix lifted gross margin to 60.2% even as it spent much more on advertising.

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: +3% YoY; $0.97 on the company's Base Business measure

segments.name: North America
segments.note: Toothpaste, toothbrushes and home care in the US and Canada — the one division that shrank, as volume fell 3.7% and pricing only partly made it back.

segments.name: Latin America
segments.note: The biggest and fastest-growing division this quarter — volume, pricing and a 6.5% currency tailwind all helped. Shown $1M above the reported $1,326M so the divisions add exactly to the $5,369M total (the release notes rounding).

segments.name: Europe, Middle East & Africa
segments.note: Sales across Europe, the Middle East and Africa — volume and pricing grew, currency took 1.2% back.

segments.name: Asia Pacific
segments.note: Sales across Asia and the Pacific — pricing up 2.8% and volume up 1.9%.

segments.name: Hill's Pet Nutrition
segments.note: Pet food sold through vets and specialty stores — 22% of all sales, growing on pricing (+3.9%) and volume (+1.8%) even as Colgate exits private-label pet food.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Selling and running the business — it includes $775M of advertising, up 15% YoY as Colgate invests behind its brands.

opex.name: Other expense, net
opex.note: Miscellaneous operating costs outside the main selling and admin line.

otherDetail: A net $69M cost below operating profit: $62M of interest expense and $24M of non-service pension costs, partly offset by $17M of interest income.
footerNote: The flow uses total net income of $779M; after $28M attributable to noncontrolling interests, net income attributable to Colgate-Palmolive was $751M ($0.94 per diluted share). Divisions use the reporting structure adopted in Q1 2026.

takeaways.title: Growth everywhere but North America
takeaways.text: Net sales rose in four of five divisions and in all four product categories. Latin America led at +12.5%; North America fell 1.7% as shoppers bought less, even with prices up 2.2%.

takeaways.title: Each sale got more profitable
takeaways.text: Gross margin widened 80 basis points to 60.2% — pricing and cost savings beat the cost of ingredients and packaging. Colgate raised its full-year gross-margin guidance on the strength of it.

takeaways.title: Advertising is the reinvestment
takeaways.text: Advertising jumped 15% to $775M — the main reason operating margin eased to 20.3% despite the better gross margin. Management is deliberately spending the margin gains on brand support.
